notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crookshank Kobolds.
description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.
